title: Plugin tier declaration
description: Ships at the root of a plugin payload as tier.json and states whether that plugin is ubiquitous or gated on a stack. The plugin and marketplace identity is taken from the installed path, never declared here.

stack.description: Human name of the stack, used in the session statement and the block message.

owner_repository.description: owner/name of the repository that authors this tier, or several when its remotes differ. The gate never fires inside one, so a tier's own standards stay readable while they are being edited.

detect.description: Present when any one matcher matches. Required for applies=stack-present and meaningless otherwise.

files.description: Repository-relative paths that exist only when the stack does.

globs.description: Filename patterns matched at any depth.

content.description: A file whose name matches glob and whose text matches pattern.
